evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: The contract is framed around reliable, fast return — capability of the system and stability of the guarantee.
Appeals to security and reliability — work is preserved, nothing degrades; the system's competence is asserted through loss-prevention.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The design offers the agent self-directed choice of retrieval cadence — autonomy in how to consume results, competence in controlling the workflow.
